description: Implementation of an H264 video decoder using OpenH264, including initialization, decoding, flushing, and error handling.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: A class that handles decoding of H264 video streams using OpenH264, managing codec lifecycle, input buffers, and output frames.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up callback functions for decoder status and error reporting.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state, stops decoding thread, clears buffers and configurations.

methods.name: InitializeCodec
methods.description: Creates and initializes the OpenH264 decoder.

methods.name: TeardownCodec
methods.description: Uninitializes and destroys the OpenH264 decoder, releases decode targets if needed.

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Accepts input buffers for decoding, schedules decoding tasks.

methods.name: DecodeOneBuffer
methods.description: Decodes a single input buffer, handles keyframe config updates.

methods.name: FlushFrames
methods.description: Flushes remaining frames from the decoder, processes output frames.

methods.name: ProcessDecodedImage
methods.description: Processes a decoded frame, creates video frame objects, manages output queue.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream, triggers flushing of remaining frames.

methods.name: DecodeEndOfStream
methods.description: Handles end of stream decoding and final output.

methods.name: UpdateDecodeTarget_Locked
methods.description: Creates or updates the decode target from the current frame.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decode target for rendering in decode-to-texture mode.

methods.name: ReportError
methods.description: Reports an error via callback, schedules if called from a different thread.
